purpose: Materialize the already completed bounded v2.0.2 release-readiness and remediation review for the qualified candidate, without performing another broad audit or authorizing release publication.

requirements.statement: The review is bound to the qualified candidate and its approved Bootstrap Source Identity.
The review is bounded to the approved v2.0.2 remediation and must distinguish supported remediation from deferred or out-of-scope work.
The review consumes the already accepted candidate validation and candidate-bound eval results without rerunning validation.
The accepted SemVer determination for v2.0.2 must be preserved.
KI-001 must remain an unresolved non-blocking known limitation; KI-002 remediation must remain supported; issue #14 must remain deferred; issues #3-#8 must remain outside release scope.
Issues #9-#13 may be recorded only as technically supported by implementation and validation evidence, without claiming issue closure.
The initial fresh-child zero-test invocation must remain classified as tooling or invocation behavior because the transformed child assembly subsequently compiled and passed 4-of-4 EditMode tests.
PASS may recommend pre-Container release-evidence materialization only; it must not claim Container B, finalization, tagging, publication, or release approval.
